title: ISO creatine monohydrate — who has domestic stock under $6/kg?
body: Brand launch in 6 weeks. Need 5,000 kg USP grade with COA and lead time under 10 days. Prefer Midwest warehouse.

replies.body: Nordic Actives had a lot on the board last week — check Shop all. We closed at $5.80/kg FOB Illinois.

title: COA red flags on near-expiry collagen?
body: Seeing lots with 90-day expiry windows. What do you require beyond standard peptide profile — heavy metals, microbiology?

replies.body: We require full panel within 12 months and retest if expiry is under 120 days. Ask supplier for original manufacturer COA, not broker repack.
+1 on retest. Also confirm bovine vs marine source on the COA header matches listing.

title: LTL vs FTL for 8,000 kg whey isolate — cost tradeoffs
body: Supplier quoted $8.90/kg but freight is killing us on partial truckload from West Coast. Anyone consolidated recently?

title: Stand-up pouch MOQ for 500g protein SKUs
body: Looking for matte 500g pouches with zipper, food grade. Need 25k units with 3-week turnaround. Artwork ready.

replies.body: PouchPack Industries lists 96k gloss 500g units on the marketplace — might negotiate matte run if you take full lot.

title: Natural vanilla bourbon — heat stability for RTD
body: Reformulating RTD protein. Current flavor failing heat stability above 185°F. Alternatives that survive UHT?

title: Best practices for supplier onboarding checks
body: What documentation do you collect before first PO with a new ingredient supplier found through the marketplace?

replies.body: W-9, FDA registration, liability cert, spec sheet, and two references. We also ask for a trial COA lot before bulk.
